Same convention as oracle/goldens/object/size-backlog.json: structurally EQUAL fixtures whose maxSizeDeltaIn (inches, max across their svek-N graphs) is not yet 0; the test asserts delta <= pinned + 1e-6 per graph, so deltas only shrink. Phase L size iterations drive entries to 0 and DELETE them (absent slug = 0 required). Captured 2026-07-11 at ratchet creation. skin-loading B2 note (nimana-36-veco708): the G8 tracked exception is RESOLVED. The skin-file-loading mission landed `skin <name>` stylesheet loading + state drop-shadow rendering/ink (skin rose Shadowing=4.0 now draws the filter and reserves 2*shadow=8px), so this entry improved 0.111111 -> 0.043169 (below its pre-G8 0.090278). The remaining 0.043169 is a pre-existing NON-shadow size gap on another svek graph of this fixture (a separate size-parity follow-up, not skin/shadow), pinned tighten-only here. INHERENT-TOLERANCE EXCLUSIONS (added 2026-08-10): corumi-91-mizo869 and gupeto-19-mesa256 are NOT defects and must not be driven to 0. Both carry the same <math>S<=1/(F+(1-F)/N)</math> label and both pinned at the identical 1.106597. PROVENANCE CORRECTED 2026-09-02: that 1.106597 was NOT the KaTeX divergence this note originally named. When it was taken, CommandCreoleMath was not ported, so the label measured as 33 characters of literal tag-inclusive TEXT -- measure('<math>S<=1/(F+(1-F)/N)</math>', 14pt).width = 206.675, +20 margins = 226.675px = 3.148in, less the jar's 2.041667in = 1.106597 exactly. The pin recorded a MISSING CREOLE COMMAND. CommandCreoleMath is ported now (2026-09-02) and both entries fell to 0.305555; THAT residual is the genuine inherent cause: <math> renders through KaTeX where the jar uses JLaTeXMath, a PERMANENT maintainer-approved divergence (DIVERGENCES.md, 'LaTeX rendering engine'). Note further that this corpus's own latex oracles are all getRollback() monospace renderings, not JLaTeXMath output at all -- see plans/sequence-creole/findings/latex-oracles-are-rollbacks.md -- so no width comparison against them is meaningful. They stay pinned shrink-only for non-regression but are excluded from the conformant denominator, exactly as the description suite treats gevozu-46/sunuju-01. Before this note the state backlog had NO divergence language at all, so these two read as ordinary work items. The transition-label ink fold became jar-faithful -- upstream folds TextBlockMarged's own UEmpty (the marged block, measuredWidth + 2*marginLabel, anchored at the reserved box corner: TextBlockMarged.java:79-87 + LimitFinder.java:159-162), not the floored DOT reservation at the text anchor. All six composites were ALREADY smaller than jar's by a SEPARATE mechanism, and the old over-wide fold was partly cancelling that; correcting it unmasks the residual. The rule is not in doubt: on bunade-42-fudu910 jar's own SVG puts its rightmost label box at 90.464 + 54.8125 = 145.2765 and its ink min at 25.72, extent 119.5565 against the 119.557 its declared 154.557 - 35 implies. The same commit took measure-composite-declared-size from 2454 to 2469 exact with zero exact->non-exact, and shape-match-report from 776/25695 to 779/25952. What remains on these six is a label-POSITION divergence (~0.165px on bunade), which is its own mission -- drive these entries down there, and do not loosen any entry again without an equivalent jar-verified account. T3 RE-PIN (2026-08-18, mission state-declared-size-fix/T3, decisions.md#D3): ported `ReadFilterMergeLines` (preproc2/ReadFilterMergeLines.java:57-81) at both its chain positions (`BlockUmlBuilder.ts`'s `buildBlockUmls`, matching `Preprocessor.java:50-54`; `IncludeExecutor.ts#executeIncludesub`, matching `TContext.java:661`) -- a trailing-`\` physical line now merges with the next before block splitting / command dispatch, as the jar does. duzazu-41-telu529 and vixobo-14-jole910's `Active` composite HEIGHT rows are now byte-exact (were the G3 mechanism: 3 dropped continuation lines under `state Active { Active: SEND_MSG (...) / \` never reached `measureAutonomWrapper`'s description text at all). Each fixture's entry TIGHTENED, not removed: a residual WIDTH-only delta remains (duzazu-41 0.311805 -> 0.194444in; vixobo-14 0.388889 -> 0.194444in), confirmed by direct probe of the merged content (`buildBlockUmls` output matches entry/exit's already-correct `\n\t` pattern byte-for-byte) that the join itself is correct and `measureLines`/`splitStateDisplayLines` (shared by `state-sizing.ts` and `state-composite-sizing.ts`) receive it -- so this residual is the SAME class of gap as fibudu-53-bode309's #b row below (`measureAutonomWrapper`'s width computation, not the merge), out of T3's write-set. fibudu-53-bode309's #a row (the same merge mechanism, `attribute-line.md`) is likewise now exact; its #b row (0.388888 -> 0.173785in) is the pre-identified T6 residual, left untouched per the batch overview. Closing it is a core creole feature outside T6's write-set; see the T6 row of plans/state-declared-size-fix/decision-journal.md. Loosened tighten-elsewhere: this entry is now bound by the #b residual alone, not by the (now-fixed) G10 leaf-width bug. Batch 5 (fovafu #b) inherits the new value. JUVAGU-33 RE-PIN (2026-08-18, mission state-declared-size-fix/T6, human ruling in decision-journal batch-2): juvagu-33-dupa212 LOOSENED 0.489844 -> 1.160677in. T6 made the AtomText tab-stop advance jar-exact (jar's own in.svg draws this description's superscript at x=68 = tab stop 56 + margins, which we now reproduce), which moved the still-literal `<sup>1</sup>` text (89.69px, 12 chars) AFTER a correct 56px advance instead of before it: 56 + 6.119 (jar's 11pt '1') + 20 = 82.119 = jar's declared box exactly, so the entire residual is the unported <sup>/<sub> creole command (CommandCreoleBuilder.java:104-105,111 registers CommandCreoleExposantChange -> FontPosition EXPOSANT/INDICE, FontPosition.java mute=size-3 clamp 2 / getSpace -6/+3; this port's FontConfiguration.ts has no fontPosition and CommandCreoleBuilder.ts never registers the command). Drive this entry down there; do not loosen again without an equivalent jar-verified account. T8 RE-PIN (2026-08-18, mission state-declared-size-fix/T8, decisions.md#D5): SI28 G4 closed. Two changes, both jar-cited. (1) The two ink-extent seams (`state-composite-autonom.ts#buildPlainAutonomSpec`, `state-composite-concurrent.ts#regionInkGeometry`) now pass their own pass's real `clusterPosMapOf(result)` instead of `undefined`, so `materializeCluster` stops falling back to `boundingBox(children)` and folds the nested cluster's graphviz box (`Cluster#setPosition` from `DotStringFactory.java:434`, widened by `Cluster#manageEntryExitPoint` `Cluster.java:410-436` + `ClusterHeader.java:81-95` where border points exist). Upstream paints that box for EVERY cluster in `SvekResult#drawU` (`SvekResult.java:71-74`), so `SvekResult#calculateDimension`'s getMinMax walk (`SvekResult.java:129-135`) folds it at every seam that reads it (`InnerStateAutonom.java:186-197`, `ConcurrentStates.java:133-141`) -- no nested-inside-an-autonom-pass special case exists. (2) `shiftDotLayoutResult` now translates `clusters` as well as nodes and edges, mirroring the THIRD loop of `DotStringFactory#moveDelta` (`DotStringFactory.java:653-663` -> `Cluster#moveDelta` `Cluster.java:127-136`), which is the very moveDelta `SvekResult.java:133` fires; without it a nested cluster rendered (dx,dy) off its own members. (b) fovafu-44-mifu394's scope-2 WIDTH row moved -4.180px -> +7.820px (its height row closed -10.996px -> +1.004px -> exact, and the entry as a whole still TIGHTENED). A dot-engine geometry delta, not a sizing rule; do not chase it here.
